svg.title: Lecture & Meeting AI pipeline
svg.desc: Lecture and meeting AI pipeline (Illinois State University DeepLearners): lecture or meeting audio is preprocessed with ffmpeg (resampled to 16 kHz, chunked by voice activity), run in parallel batches on a Dask cluster of Linux workers, transcribed by a Whisper ASR model fine-tuned on lecture audio into a transcript with timestamps, summarized by a LoRA fine-tuned LLM into key points and action items, and stored in a SQL database that an HTML/CSS/JS web app reads and writes for upload, search and viewing.
